title: news home check
description: Code checks on a draft curation, against the pages as PostgreSQL has them now (TD "Home page curation" and ADR 0005; the write API runs the same rules again). A passing draft becomes `checked`; failures go back to the curator. Failure codes: schema.invalid, page_missing, page_unpublished, page_withdrawn, duplicate_page, figure_not_on_page, chart_not_on_page, breadth_categories, breadth_regions, breadth_entity, breadth_non_finance, lead_stale. Input is the command's arguments as an object; output is the envelope's data.

path.description: JSON Pointer into the draft's body, when the failure is at one slot.

results.description: One entry per rule: the `checks.results` a published curation carries.
